description: Test suite for preference store functions in Mattermost, including saving, retrieving, deleting preferences, and cleaning up orphaned or invalid preferences.

methods.name: TestPreferenceStore
methods.description: Main test function executing various preference store related tests.

methods.name: testPreferenceSave
methods.description: Tests saving preferences and retrieving them to verify correctness.

methods.name: testPreferenceGet
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific preference and error handling for missing preferences.

methods.name: testPreferenceGetCategoryAndName
methods.description: Tests retrieving preferences by category and name, including multiple users and categories.

methods.name: testPreferenceGetCategory
methods.description: Tests retrieving preferences by user and category.

methods.name: testPreferenceGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all preferences for a user.

methods.name: testPreferenceDeleteByUser
methods.description: Tests deleting all preferences for a specific user.

methods.name: testPreferenceDeleteCategory
methods.description: Tests deleting all preferences within a category for a user.

methods.name: testPreferenceDeleteCategoryAndName
methods.description: Tests deleting preferences by category and name for multiple users.

methods.name: testPreferenceDeleteOrphanedRows
methods.description: Tests cleanup of orphaned preference rows after related posts are deleted.

methods.name: testPreferenceCleanupFlagsBatch
methods.description: Tests batch cleanup of orphaned preferences, including edge cases with invalid limits.

methods.name: testDeleteInvalidVisibleDmsGms
methods.description: Tests deletion of preferences with invalid values for visible DMs/GMs limits.
